title: HTML Reference
description: A compact reference of the HTML elements covered in the tutorial, grouped by purpose, with syntax, a short example and the lesson that explains each one.

entries.name: <!DOCTYPE html>
entries.summary: Declares a modern HTML document; must be the first line.

entries.name: <html>
entries.summary: The root element containing head and body. Set the page language with lang.

entries.name: <head>
entries.summary: Metadata about the document: title, character set, viewport, stylesheets, scripts.

entries.name: <title>
entries.summary: The document title shown in the tab and in search results. Required, one per document.

entries.name: <meta>
entries.summary: Metadata such as character encoding, viewport settings, description and Open Graph data.

example.code:
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<meta name="description" content="…">

entries.name: <link>
entries.summary: Links an external resource, most often a stylesheet, icon or canonical URL.

entries.name: <script>
entries.summary: Embeds or references JavaScript. Use defer for external scripts so they do not block rendering.

entries.name: <body>
entries.summary: All visible content of the page.
A comment ignored by the browser but visible in the source.

entries.name: <header>
entries.summary: Introductory content for the page or a section: logo, title, navigation.

entries.name: <nav>
entries.summary: A block of navigation links. Label multiple navs with aria-label.

entries.name: <main>
entries.summary: The unique primary content of the page. Exactly one per page.

entries.name: <section>
entries.summary: A thematic group of content, normally with its own heading.

entries.name: <article>
entries.summary: Self-contained content that makes sense on its own, such as a post or product.

entries.name: <aside>
entries.summary: Content related to but separate from the main content: sidebars, related links.

entries.name: <footer>
entries.summary: Closing information for the page or a section: copyright, contact, links.

entries.name: <address>
entries.summary: Contact information for the nearest article or the whole page.

entries.name: <h1>–<h6>
entries.summary: Six levels of section headings; h1 is the page title, lower levels create sub-sections.

entries.name: <div>
entries.summary: A generic block container with no meaning; use it for styling or scripting when no semantic element fits.
A paragraph of text.
A line break within text (addresses, poems). Not for spacing.

entries.name: <hr>
entries.summary: A thematic break between paragraphs, rendered as a horizontal rule.

entries.name: <pre>
entries.summary: Preformatted text; whitespace and line breaks are preserved.

entries.name: <blockquote>
entries.summary: A quotation that forms its own block; cite holds the source URL.

entries.name: <ul>
entries.summary: An unordered (bulleted) list of li items.

entries.name: <ol>
entries.summary: An ordered (numbered) list; supports start, reversed and type.

entries.name: <li>
entries.summary: A list item inside ul or ol.

entries.name: <dl>, <dt>, <dd>
entries.summary: A description list of terms (dt) and descriptions (dd).

entries.name: <figure>, <figcaption>
entries.summary: Self-contained content such as an image or diagram, with an optional caption.

entries.name: <details>, <summary>
entries.summary: A disclosure widget that shows its content when the summary is clicked.

entries.name: <a>
entries.summary: A hyperlink to another page, a section (#id), a file, an email (mailto:) or phone (tel:).

entries.name: <strong>
entries.summary: Strong importance; rendered bold.

entries.name: <em>
entries.summary: Stress emphasis; rendered italic.

entries.name: <b>, <i>
entries.summary: Bold and italic without extra meaning (keywords, alternate voice).

entries.name: <mark>
entries.summary: Highlighted text relevant in the current context.

entries.name: <small>
entries.summary: Side comments and fine print.

entries.name: <del>, <ins>
entries.summary: Deleted and inserted text (edits).

entries.name: <sub>, <sup>
entries.summary: Subscript and superscript.

entries.name: <code>
entries.summary: A fragment of computer code; combine with pre for blocks.

entries.name: <kbd>, <samp>, <var>
entries.summary: Keyboard input, program output and a variable name.

entries.name: <abbr>
entries.summary: An abbreviation; title gives the expansion.

entries.name: <q>, <cite>
entries.summary: A short inline quotation and the title of a cited work.

entries.name: <time>
entries.summary: A date or time with a machine-readable datetime attribute.

entries.name: <span>
entries.summary: A generic inline container with no meaning.
An image. Always include src, alt, width and height; use loading="lazy" below the fold.

entries.name: <picture>, <source>
entries.summary: Offer alternative image formats or crops; the browser chooses the first source it supports.

entries.name: <audio>
entries.summary: Embedded sound with native controls.

entries.name: <video>
entries.summary: Embedded video with controls, poster, multiple sources and caption tracks.

entries.name: <track>
entries.summary: Captions, subtitles or descriptions (WebVTT) for a video or audio element.

entries.name: <iframe>
entries.summary: Embeds another document, such as a hosted video player. Always set a title.

entries.name: <canvas>
entries.summary: A bitmap drawing surface controlled by JavaScript.

entries.name: <table>
entries.summary: A table of data (never for layout).

entries.name: <caption>
entries.summary: The title of a table, as its first child.

entries.name: <thead>, <tbody>, <tfoot>
entries.summary: Groups of header, body and footer rows.

entries.name: <tr>
entries.summary: A single table row containing header or data cells.

entries.name: <th>
entries.summary: A header cell; scope="col" or scope="row" says what it labels.

entries.name: <td>
entries.summary: A data cell; colspan and rowspan merge cells.

entries.name: <form>
entries.summary: Groups fields and submits them to action with method get or post.

entries.name: <label>
entries.summary: A caption for a field; for must match the field's id, or wrap the field inside the label.

entries.name: <input>
entries.summary: A single-line field whose behaviour depends on type: text, email, password, number, date, checkbox, radio, file and more.

entries.name: <textarea>
entries.summary: A multi-line text field; rows and cols set the initial size.

entries.name: <select>, <option>, <optgroup>
entries.summary: A drop-down list of options, optionally grouped.

entries.name: <button>
entries.summary: A button; type is submit (default in forms), reset or button.

entries.name: <fieldset>, <legend>
entries.summary: Groups related fields under a caption.

entries.name: <datalist>
entries.summary: Suggested values for an input, referenced by the input's list attribute.

entries.name: <dialog>
entries.summary: A native dialog box; showModal() opens it with a backdrop and focus trapping.

entries.name: <template>
entries.summary: Inert markup cloned by JavaScript to create elements.
